description: This file defines classes and functions for running and analyzing performance tests, including metrics collection, test execution, output parsing, and result logging. It supports different test styles and includes a factory for creating test instances based on test name patterns.

classes.name: PerfTestMetric
classes.description: Represents a performance test metric, including its name, unit, and collected iteration values.

classes.name: PerfTest
classes.description: Base class for running performance tests, parsing output, and collecting metrics.

classes.name: SingleProcessPerfTest
classes.description: Subclass of PerfTest for single-process performance tests.

classes.name: ChromiumStylePerfTest
classes.description: Subclass of PerfTest for Chromium-style performance tests with specific output parsing.

classes.name: PerfTestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating appropriate PerfTest instances based on test name patterns.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the metric name.

methods.name: has_values
methods.description: Checks if the metric has collected values.

methods.name: append_group
methods.description: Appends a group of iteration values to the metric.

methods.name: grouped_iteration_values
methods.description: Returns all collected iteration groups.

methods.name: flattened_iteration_values
methods.description: Returns all iteration values flattened into a single list.

methods.name: unit
methods.description: Returns the unit of the metric.

methods.name: metric_to_unit
methods.description: Converts a metric type to its corresponding unit.

methods.name: time_unit_to_metric
methods.description: Converts a time unit to its corresponding metric name.

methods.name: test_name
methods.description: Returns the test name.

methods.name: test_name_without_file_extension
methods.description: Returns the test name without its file extension.

methods.name: test_path
methods.description: Returns the test path.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the test description.

methods.name: _create_driver
methods.description: Creates a driver instance for running tests.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the test multiple times and collects results.

methods.name: log_statistics
methods.description: Logs statistical analysis of test results.

methods.name: _run_with_driver
methods.description: Runs the test with a given driver and parses output.

methods.name: _ensure_metrics
methods.description: Ensures a metric object exists for a given metric name.

methods.name: run_single
methods.description: Runs a single test with a driver.

methods.name: run_failed
methods.description: Checks if the test run failed based on output.

methods.name: _should_ignore_line
methods.description: Determines if a line should be ignored based on regex patterns.

methods.name: _filter_output
methods.description: Filters out irrelevant lines from test output.

methods.name: parse_and_log_output
methods.description: Parses output for results and logs them.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, initializing attributes.
